---
name: "Feature slice"
about: "One issue is one PR-sized slice."
labels: "enhancement"
---

## Problem

Say who is blocked and what they cannot do.

## Where

Name the file and the function you expect to change.

## Acceptance criteria

Keep this issue to one pull request. If the work needs two pull requests, open two issues. Check each result this slice must deliver.

- [ ] Write one result you can check.
- [ ] Add another box for each remaining result.

## Files likely touched

List the paths you expect to edit.

- Write one path per bullet.

## Test plan

Number the checks you will run before you open the pull request.

1. Write the first check.
2. Write the next check.
